project: Real-Data E2E Loop A: Entry + Readiness Foundation
overview: Close P0 entry/readiness gaps by enforcing one canonical readiness contract across list/detail/API and deterministic Quick Start gating on real-data states.
goals: Remove contradictory readiness states between UI and API.
Enforce one canonical readiness reason model.
Keep feedback fast with pack-based smoke checks.
nonGoals: Implementing run lifecycle normalization (Loop B scope).
Implementing citation/export contract changes (Loop C scope).
Broad demo-prod parity beyond explicit Phase 0 allowlist quick wins.
successMetrics: pack_01_clean and pack_02_missing_rea produce consistent readiness outcomes across list/detail/API.
Quick Start never starts when readiness is blocked.
Setup failures are explicitly surfaced with recovery guidance.
openQuestions: Should readiness reason codes be centralized in a shared enum module before Loop B starts?
Do we require a dedicated telemetry dashboard for readiness mismatches in this phase?

stack.hosting: Local dev and demo-prod operator surfaces
stack.auth: Existing mode and route gating (dev/demo-prod), no auth model changes in this slice

routes.name: Matters list
routes.purpose: Surface entry and readiness state summaries

routes.name: Matter detail
routes.purpose: Surface setup/readiness details and Quick Start gating

routes.name: Run start API
routes.purpose: Enforce readiness preconditions and conflict behavior

uiNotes: Blocked, runnable, and already-complete states must show explicit reason copy.
Quick Start disabled state must include actionable guidance.
Setup failures must render deterministic banners with retry affordances.

importFormat.description: Operator pack-driven setup and readiness checks use existing demo/load and setup APIs; no new file format is introduced.

rules: Canonical readiness state must be the single source of truth for UI and run-start behavior.
Blocked readiness must fail loudly with explicit reason codes.
No optimistic-ready fallback is allowed when prerequisites are missing.
Each story must be verified with at least one pack fixture and one negative path.

stories.title: Canonical readiness contract across list/detail/API
stories.description: As an operator, I want list and detail readiness signals to match API truth so I can trust whether a matter is runnable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given pack_01_clean, readiness resolves to runnable in both list and detail surfaces and the same state is returned by readiness-dependent APIs.
Given pack_02_missing_rea, readiness resolves to blocked with explicit reason text in list/detail/API payloads.
Example: detail page shows blocked required document copy and run-start denial includes the same reason code family.
Negative: UI must never show ready while run-start API denies due to missing prerequisites.

stories.title: Quick Start readiness gate is deterministic
stories.description: As an operator, I want Quick Start to only run when prerequisites are satisfied so blocked matters fail loudly and predictably.
acceptanceCriteria: Quick Start is enabled only when canonical readiness state is runnable.
When readiness is blocked, Quick Start shows actionable reason copy and does not enqueue a run.
Example: remediating missing prerequisites transitions blocked to runnable and enables Quick Start without refresh hacks.
Negative: blocked start attempts cannot silently enqueue a run or return ambiguous success UI.

stories.title: Entry/setup error UX is explicit and non-silent
stories.description: As an operator, I want setup failures surfaced clearly so I can recover without guessing.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload/init/complete failures render deterministic user-facing error states with retry guidance.
Readiness recomputation failures surface explicit error code and safe recovery copy.
Example: upload completion failure shows retry CTA and does not mark readiness complete.
Negative: failures must not be swallowed into indefinite loading states.

inScope: P0 entry plus readiness gate consistency for create/upload/ingest readiness messaging.
Quick Start enablement based on real folder/document readiness state.
Readiness coverage for pack_01_clean and pack_02_missing_rea.
UX copy for blocked, runnable, and already-complete states.
functionalRequirements: FR-001: Use one canonical readiness reason model across list/detail/Quick Start API surfaces.
FR-002: Quick Start enablement logic must derive from canonical readiness contract only.
FR-003: Blocked, runnable, and already-complete states must include user-visible reason copy.
FR-004: Error envelopes for setup/readiness failures must map to deterministic UI banners.
FR-005: Maintain compatibility with existing dev-first mode posture and no new prod-path enablement.
failureStatesAndUX: Missing prerequisite documents: blocked state with explicit reason and next step.
Upload/init/complete failure: deterministic error banner and retry affordance.
Readiness recomputation failure: safe fallback state with recovery action.
metricsLogging: readiness_state_mismatch_detected count between UI and API (target 0 in smoke packs).
rollbackDisablePath: Keep canonical-readiness mapping behind an additive toggle until smoke validation completes.
If disabled, preserve existing blocked-default behavior rather than optimistic ready states.

risks: Hidden seeded/fallback branches can still leak contradictory readiness states.
Error copy drift between route handlers and UI components can reintroduce ambiguity.
dependencies: Uses existing create/upload/readiness APIs in apps/web/app/(api)/folders/*.
Provides readiness contract inputs required by Loop B run-start normalization.

verificationPlan: Load pack_01_clean and pack_02_missing_rea and compare readiness across /matters, /matters/[id], and run-start behavior.
Run targeted readiness and run-start guard tests.
Perform manual spot checks for blocked, runnable, and recovery states.
